companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Company domains, names, or careers URLs. Paste your target-account list as-is: stripe.com, www.ramp.com, https://jobs.lever.co/shieldai all work. Prefix with a platform to skip detection, e.g. ashby:ramp.

titleKeywords.title: Title keywords
titleKeywords.description: Keep only jobs whose title contains any of these. Leave empty to keep all.

excludeKeywords.title: Exclude keywords
excludeKeywords.description: Drop jobs whose title or department matches any of these.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Keep only jobs whose location contains any of these.

departments.title: Departments
departments.description: Keep only jobs in these departments or teams.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within (days)
postedWithinDays.description: Keep only jobs posted in the last N days. 0 means no limit. Useful for daily hiring-signal runs.

includeDescription.title: Include full description
includeDescription.description: Adds the full job description as plain text. Makes results much larger.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: How many companies to fetch in parallel.
